title: st.selectbox in sidebar clipping/overflows instead of flipping up (regression in 1.59)
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues. - [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue. - [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue. ### Summary In the sidebar when st.selectbox sits near the bottom, the component opens its dropdown downward and the options overflow past the bottom of the viewport instead of flipping upward. This changed between 1.58 and 1.59/1.60: in 1.58 the same app flips the dropdown upward so it stays on screen; in 1.59 it opens downward and overflows. This issue only occurs in the sidebar. Observed rendered DOM difference (offered as evidence): in 1.58 the open listbox renders at the document root as a sibling of #portal (ul[data-testid="stSelectboxVirtualDropdown"]), so its placement is viewport-relative and it flips. In 1.59 the widget is a react-aria-ComboBox and the open listbox renders inside [data-testid="stSidebar"], which is position: relative, so it is anchored to the sidebar and opens downward only. ### Reproducible Code Example ```Python import streamlit as st st.set_page_config(layout="wide") with st.sidebar: st.title("Controls") # Spacer content to push the selectbox to the bottom of the sidebar / viewport. # Adjust the range if your screen is very tall and the box isn't near the bottom. for _ in range(12): st.markdown("---") st.selectbox( "Choose a section:", ["Option 1", "Option 2", "Option 3", "Option 4", "Option 5", "Option 6", "Option 7"], ) st.title("Streamlit Dropdown Demo") st.write("Expand the sidebar and open the selectbox at the bottom.") ``` ### Steps To Reproduce 1. Make sure the sidebar is expanded and the browser window is tall enough that the spacer content pushes the selectbox down to the bottom of the sidebar, near the bottom edge of the viewport. 2. Scroll to the bottom of the side bar if necessary. 3. Click the "Choose a section:" selectbox at the bottom of the sidebar to open it. 4. Observe that the option list opens downward and extends past the bottom of the viewport. See example screenshot for selectbox list cutoff ### Expected Behavior The dropdown flips upward when there is insufficient space below, staying within the viewport (this is the 1.58.0 behavior). ### Current Behavior _No response_ ### Is this a regression? - [x] Yes, this used to work in a previous version. ### Debug info - Streamlit version: 1.59.0 - Python version: 3.10.11 - Operating System: Windows 11 - Browser: Edge ### Additional Information _No response_

Your feedback helps us prioritize which bugs to investigate and address first.

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-16181)

### Triage summary

This is a confirmed-looking layout **regression** in the new (`react-aria-components`) `st.selectbox`/ComboBox introduced in 1.59. When a selectbox sits near the bottom of the **sidebar**, its dropdown opens downward and overflows past the viewport instead of flipping up as it did in 1.58.

**Likely root cause:** the dropdown is positioned via Floating UI, but flipping is explicitly disabled inside the sidebar. In `frontend/lib/src/components/shared/Dropdown/Selectbox.tsx` the positioning hook is called with:

```tsx
const { refs, floatingStyles } = useFloatingOverlay({
  open: true,
  placement: "bottom-start",
  offsetPx: convertRemToPx(theme.spacing.twoXS),
  flipOptions: isInSidebar ? false : undefined, // <-- disables flip in the sidebar
  matchTriggerWidth: true,
})
```

In `useFloatingOverlay` (`frontend/lib/src/hooks/useFloatingOverlay.ts`), `flipOptions === false` drops the `flip()` middleware entirely, so the popover can no longer flip to `top` when there isn't enough space below — it just opens downward and gets clipped. This matches the reporter's DOM observation that in 1.59 the listbox renders inside `[data-testid="stSidebar"]` (which is `position: relative`) rather than at the document root as a sibling of `#portal` like in 1.58. This flip-disabling was added in the Floating UI scroll-tracking change (#15638); it was presumably meant to avoid the popover escaping the sidebar's bounds (the BaseWeb `Multiselect` uses the analogous `ignoreBoundary: isInSidebar`), but it also unintentionally removed the upward-flip behavior. A fix likely needs to keep flip enabled while constraining/shifting the popover against the viewport rather than fully disabling `flipOptions` in the sidebar.

### Related Issues

- [#12260 – Regression: Selectbox/Multiselect keyboard focus not activating on mobile](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/12260): Another regression in the same widgets tied to the `react-aria` ComboBox rewrite — useful as a sibling regression from the same migration.
- [#12865 – Fullscreen menu partially hidden in fixed height containers](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/12865): Same class of bug — an overlay/menu getting clipped by a relatively-positioned/overflow-constrained container's bounds instead of being viewport-aware.
- [#9340 – Popover is truncated when app is embedded](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/9340): Also an overlay positioning/clipping problem where the popover isn't rendered relative to the viewport; related conceptually rather than a duplicate.
